_doc: Copy to config/local.json (gitignored). Per-host values only; secrets are REFERENCES resolved by ops/fleet_kit/fleet_secrets.py, never a literal value here.

loop._doc: tools/al_loop.py tick. inbox_dir / outbox_dir: blank = <repo>/moon_sync_inbox and <repo>/moon_sync_outbox. max_notes_per_day: kit item 14 cap 12 (may lower, never raise; ORDER / FIX / RULING exempt). max_new_plans_per_day: ROADMAP rows an idle deep-dive may propose per day. dest_inboxes {CODE: dir}: where a reply is byte-copied (else the fleet roster). routes {kind: {model, effort}}: incident override of the ROUTES table (invalid entries ignored).

_doc_core: server.al and the overlay read these top-level keys. client_log: blank = auto-discover the Steam install's logs/Client.txt (read only, after consent). character: optional name filter. poll_ms: tail poll interval. overlay_toggle: Electron accelerator for show/hide. eval_hotkey: Electron accelerator for the item check (reads the clipboard once per press). port: null = 8960 (block 8960-8979).
_doc_web: web_data: the one web-data opt-in (decision 0013), default false; while false nothing is requested from the web (poe.ninja rates, pasted share links, price checks). Also set by POST /api/web-data. league: optional league id for poe.ninja rates and price checks; blank = the current league from the site's league list. contact: how GGG / poe.ninja can reach you, appended to the User-Agent as (contact: <value>) because both ask for one; set it HERE only (this file is gitignored), never in a tracked file. Blank = poe.ninja rates, price checks and GGG data fetches stay off even with web_data on (pasted share links still work).
_doc_tc: tc_calc: opt-in for the optional theorycraft calc component (TC-PIN, decision 0018), default false. When true, scripts/setup.ps1 fetches the hash-pinned Path of Building PoE2 source and LuaJIT (config/tc_pins.json) into the sidecar and verifies them; same as setup.ps1 -TcCalc. The running core also reads it (AUDIT-TC-WIRE): with it true and the component installed, item checks use Path of Building DPS and EHP deltas; otherwise they use the stat weights.
